declared_exclusions.item: A browser or visual render of the Peers tab, and any network call
declared_exclusions.reason: Bounds 2 and 3 of the order forbid a deploy, a store write, an AWS call and network use; the checker renders the actual PeersTab.tsx with react-dom/server against captured fixtures, which is the instrument the order names.

declared_exclusions.item: bun install in the portal worktree
declared_exclusions.reason: Forbidden by Bounds 3 of the order; node_modules is a link to the main tree and was used as is.

declared_exclusions.item: Push, PROD touch and deploy of the portal branch
declared_exclusions.reason: Forbidden by Bounds 1, 3 and 4; the commit stays LOCAL on wk-AMGT_RESAPP-384-portal.

declared_exclusions.item: JSX entity form (') for the sentence apostrophes
declared_exclusions.reason: The sentence is built as one JS string from two dates (a template literal in a const), not literal JSX text, so its apostrophes are ASCII inside the string; React escapes them on render as ', which the checker reads. Non-ASCII is absent from the product code.

declared_exclusions.item: The <status> flip of the task order
declared_exclusions.reason: The order states the status flip is the issuer's; this worker does not flip it.

surprises: AMGT_RESAPP-D1-W384-S1: The product files live in the nested portal repository, so the order commit-in-the-worktree instruction lands the product commit in a second repository.
AMGT_RESAPP-D1-W384-S2: The nested portal repository has no committer identity, so safe-commit refused rc=128 until the committer was named for that one call.
AMGT_RESAPP-D1-W384-S3: The pre-commit gate and risk reflex read zero of the two .ts/.tsx files, so their clean lines carry no evidence for this frontend commit.
